stories.title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees, Says He Is in Therapy
stories.summary: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, apologized to his employees for violating the company's code of conduct and admitted to making mistakes. This apology came a day after his return to the company, and he also mentioned he is seeking therapy.

stories.title: Hackers may have used AI tool to attack CIA and other US spy agencies
stories.summary: Hackers might have utilized an AI tool to carry out attacks against the CIA and other US intelligence agencies.

stories.title: Australia Passes Law To Punish Big Tech For Harmful Content With Fines, Why India Must Take Note
stories.summary: Australia has enacted a new Digital Duty of Care law that mandates large technology companies to actively address harmful content on their platforms. Non-compliance could result in significant fines, up to five percent of their global revenue.

stories.title: 'AI May Trick Us': Why Anthropic, OpenAI Researchers Reportedly Fear Releasing The Latest Models
stories.summary: Researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly concerned that their most advanced AI models could become uncontrollable. These safety concerns might lead the companies to delay the release of these powerful systems.

stories.title: Your Digital Govt Records At High Hacking Risk: Cybersecurity Agency Finds Major Security Flaw
stories.summary: A cybersecurity agency has identified a significant security flaw in DIGIT Core version 2.9, a platform used by governments to develop digital services. This vulnerability puts digital government records at a high risk of hacking.

stories.title: Stock Sell-Off Set to Continue as A.I. Players Fall Again
stories.summary: Shares of technology companies, including Nvidia and Anthropic, continued to decline in premarket trading. This ongoing sell-off is influenced by investor concerns about tariffs and interest rates.

stories.title: Sensex Surges Over 2,000 Points, Nifty At 25,920; Top Factors Why Stock Market Is Rising Today
stories.summary: The Sensex surged over 2,000 points and the Nifty reached 25,920, indicating a strong market rally. This rise is attributed to factors such as foreign institutional investor inflows, gains in banking stocks, a stronger rupee, and lower crude oil prices.

stories.title: Trump Administration Unveils New Tariffs for Dozens of Countries, Citing Unfair Practices
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced new tariffs on several countries, citing unfair trade practices. This action occurs as the administration faces legal challenges and increased scrutiny from the new Democratic-led Congress.

stories.title: Why the Nvidia Rally Fizzled
stories.summary: Investors are reportedly losing confidence in the artificial intelligence sector, which has impacted Nvidia's stock performance. Despite Jensen Huang's leadership, the enthusiasm for the AI boom that Nvidia has supported appears to be diminishing.

stories.title: Centre Approves Rs 11,000 Crore Scheme To Boost India's Construction Equipment Manufacturing
stories.summary: India has approved an 11,000 crore rupee scheme to enhance its construction equipment manufacturing sector. The initiative aims to decrease reliance on imports and increase exports over an eight-year period.

stories.title: Trump’s Intervention at Nvidia Sparks Bipartisan Backlash
stories.summary: There has been a bipartisan negative reaction to former President Trump's involvement with Nvidia.

stories.title: In address to jatha from India, Pak PM’s son calls for dialogue, reopening of Kartarpur Corridor
stories.summary: The son of Pakistan's Prime Minister has advocated for discussions and the reopening of the Kartarpur Corridor during a speech to a group from India.

stories.title: U.S. Spy Agencies Suffer Breach of Some Unclassified Information
stories.summary: U.S. intelligence agencies, including the C.I.A. and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, experienced a security breach involving some unclassified data. This incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding cybersecurity.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi assets case: SC quashes Allahabad HC orders seeking CBI, ED inquiry
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has overturned the Allahabad High Court's directives that called for an inquiry by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.

stories.title: 6 years after split, Akalis & BJP tie up for Punjab assembly polls
stories.summary: Six years after their separation, the Akalis and BJP have reunited to contest the Punjab assembly elections together.

stories.title: H-1B premium processing costs $2,965 ahead of FY2028 lottery: What Indian F-1 OPT workers must know about rules and cap-gap
stories.summary: The cost for H-1B premium processing is $2,965 before the FY2028 lottery. This information is important for Indian F-1 OPT workers to understand regarding the rules and cap-gap.

stories.title: IBM Ends US Visa & Green Card Sponsorship For Most Consulting Roles, Asks Staff To Relocate Or Leave
stories.summary: IBM has stopped sponsoring US visas and Green Cards for most of its consulting positions. The company is requiring affected staff to either move to a different location or leave their employment.

stories.title: Massachusetts Federal Courts Block DHS Actions Affecting International Students: Fixed Admission Period Rule Vacated, CPT Restrictions Enjoined
stories.summary: Federal courts in Massachusetts have blocked two actions by the Department of Homeland Security that impact international students. The rule establishing a fixed admission period has been vacated, and restrictions on Curricular Practical Training (CPT) have been enjoined.

stories.title: US Congressman Ro Khanna flags US visa delays, says skilled workers stranded abroad for months | Trending
stories.summary: A US Congressman has highlighted significant delays in US visa processing, noting that many skilled workers are stuck outside the country for extended periods.

stories.title: Virginia Joins 25 States Opposing Trump’s Proposed $100,000 Fee on International Students
stories.summary: Virginia has become one of 26 states to oppose a proposed $100,000 fee on international students, a measure that was put forth by former President Trump.
